concept: Claude Code system-prompt and tool-schema slimming for local models
summary: Default: 14.0k tokens (system 1.26k, 20 tool definitions 10.7k, env/agent-list/reminder message 2.1k). With telemetry/network left on, 23 tools and 18.2k tokens.

facts.text: Default: 14.0k tokens (system 1.26k, 20 tool definitions 10.7k, env/agent-list/reminder message 2.1k). With telemetry/network left on, 23 tools and 18.2k tokens.

`CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=1`: no change at all (14.0k vs 14.0k; system 1,267 vs 1,264 tokens, tools byte-identical) with the custom base URL and API-key auth, with and without `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`. The docs say it shortens the system prompt and abbreviates tool descriptions "on any model"; in this build that did not happen.
`--tools "Bash,Read,Edit,Write,Grep,Glob"`: 3.9k tokens (tools 2.4k, system 1.23k). Removing 14 tools removes about 8.3k tokens; the system prompt text does not shrink.
Same plus `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS=1`, `DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS=1`, `DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS=1`, `DISABLE_CRON=1`: 3.7k (messages 304 to 149 tokens, Bash definition smaller).
`--tools` (same six) plus `--system-prompt "<one sentence>"`: 2.7k (system 33 tokens). The custom prompt is the only way found to remove the 1.2k default system prompt short of `--bare`.

`--bare` (or `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1`): 0.75k total. System is two blocks totalling 34 tokens ("You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK." plus `CWD: <dir>` and `Date: <today>`), tools are Bash, Edit, Read at 685 tokens (the same three tools cost 1,275 in non-bare mode, so bare also abbreviates tool descriptions), no env message, no skills, no CLAUDE.md. `--bare --tools "Bash,Edit,Read"` is identical.

`--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` with six tools: system 737 tokens versus 1,230 (saves about 490) but the moved text reappears in the first message (messages 820 vs 304), so total 4.0k vs 3.9k. It is a cache-layout change, not a size reduction.
`--strict-mcp-config`: removes the user's MCP tools but not the 23 built-ins.

Claude Code's system prompt has moved toward small, server-delivered fragments; Piebald-AI's extraction (v2.1.289) lists per-fragment token counts and "compact" tool descriptions "served to newer models" (Grep compact, Glob compact, ReadFile compact 285 vs 578). Which variant a local-model session receives is not stated anywhere found.

In 2.1.289 the system prompt itself is date- and cwd-free (static ~1.26k tokens); environment data (cwd, platform, date, git status, agent types) sits in a `role: "system"` entry inside `messages`. In `--bare` mode the opposite holds: cwd and today's date are in the second system block, so a bare prefix changes at midnight and per directory.

Earlier-era numbers (Spicyneuron, "over 20,000" with skills and commands; Wolfinger "roughly 20K") describe heavier profiles than the clean 2.1.289 default measured here (14-18k); they agree once skills, commands and MCP are counted.

`--bare` and auth: documented as ignoring OAuth/keychain, requiring `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `apiKeyHelper`. Measured: `--bare` with only `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=lmstudio` (the Unsloth and LM Studio pattern) and no API key still sent its request.

Unknown model names: with `ANTHROPIC_MODEL=qwen-local` Claude Code prints that the name "isn't described by this version's model catalog", assumes a 200k window for auto-compact, and names `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` (set the real window), `[1m]` suffix, and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT=1`. This replaces the "effectiveWindow=180000 hardcoded" picture in the existing dossier for 2.1.289.

Aider's repo map needs scipy/networkx: on this machine the default path crashed with an `ImportError: dlopen(... scipy/sparse/linalg/_propack/_spropack...)`; the `--map-tokens 0` path worked. A broken optional import turns the default Aider path off without a clear message.

OpenCode injects every skill from `~/.claude/skills` and `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` (Claude-compat loading): this user's default first request was 97.9k system tokens, of which about 90k was the `<available_skills>` list. `OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE=1` alone did not remove it (92.9k); disabling the `skill` tool did (system 1.87k). A clean HOME gave 6.7k total.

OpenCode tool-disable aliasing: `"patch": false` removed `edit` and `write` too (remaining tools bash, glob, grep, read); disable `webfetch`, `task`, `todowrite`, `skill` instead to keep edit and write.

OpenCode sends a second request per session for the title agent (small model; 515 tokens, no tools) with an unrelated prefix; with one local server slot it competes with the main prefix. `small_model` in config picks the model for it.
Two OpenCode processes sharing the default data dir hung at init (second one never sent a request); measure or run them serially.

Capability loss is the cost: `--bare` leaves only Bash, Read, Edit (no Write, Grep, Glob, no subagents, no MCP, no skills, no hooks, no memory, no CLAUDE.md); Cline's compact prompt loses MCP, Focus Chain and MTP per Cline's blog; Aider's default has no tool-calling at all (edit-format text blocks).

Does `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=1` slim the prompt? Docs (env-vars page): shorter system prompt and abbreviated tool descriptions on any model. Measured 2.1.289 with custom base URL: byte-identical tools, system +2 tokens. Possible reasons (unverified): the switch is gated by a server-side experiment, or it only affects Anthropic-resolved model IDs; the docs sentence "on models where the experiment or server configuration would otherwise enable it" hints at gating.

Is "20k to 8k" right? Spicyneuron's own endpoint (custom prompt plus six tools plus env/tree) is under 8k; measured here, the same recipe with a one-sentence prompt is 2.7k and with Claude Code's own system prompt 3.9k. 8k is an upper bound of what is achievable, not a floor, and the 20k side depends on skills/commands.
Source claim that `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=low` slims the prompt is not tested here; capture showed `output_config.effort` as a separate request field, not prompt text.
Whether `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` takes effect under any combination of model ID, auth and fetched flags.
Real Qwen3.5/3.6, Gemma 4 and GLM token counts of the same payloads (cl100k is a proxy).
Task-success impact of 3 or 6 tools versus 20 on a 9B-35B local model: no controlled measurement found; only anecdotes (Rallo: 9B "chokes" on 259 tools).
Cline's full vs compact prompt token counts (only "about 10%" stated; extension not measured).
Whether a llama.cpp or MLX Anthropic-compatible endpoint renders the `role: "system"` mid-conversation entry in place, hoists it, or rejects it.
Measured locally (Claude Code 2.1.289, clean HOME, API-key auth, custom base URL, cl100k proxy): default first request is 14.0k tokens: system 1,264, 20 tools 10,679, messages 2,052
Measured locally: the same default with network features on carries 23 tools and totals 18.2k tokens
Measured locally: `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=1` produced tools JSON byte-identical in size to default and a system prompt 3 tokens larger on 2.1.289 with a custom base URL
Measured locally: `--tools "Bash,Read,Edit,Write,Grep,Glob"` gives 3.9k tokens total (system 1,230, tools 2,404, messages 304)
Measured locally: adding `--system-prompt "<one sentence>"` to the six-tool set gives 2.7k tokens total (system 33)
Measured locally: `--bare` gives 746-762 tokens total: system 34, tools Bash/Edit/Read 685, messages 27-43
Measured locally: the three tools Bash, Read, Edit cost 1,275 tokens in normal mode and 685 in `--bare` mode, so bare abbreviates tool descriptions
Measured locally: `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` moves about 490 tokens from the system prompt into the first message and does not change the total
Measured locally: five tools (SendMessage, Workflow, ScheduleWakeup, CronCreate, EnterWorktree) are about 24k of the 46k characters of default tool JSON

Measured locally: a heavy real profile (170-222 MCP/plugin tools, large CLAUDE.md, many skills) sends 66k-96k tokens before the first prompt; `--strict-mcp-config --tools <6>` cuts it to 10.2k and adding CLAUDE.md/auto-memory/git-instruction/slash-command disables cuts it to 4.2k
Measured locally: in 2.1.289 the static system prompt has no date or cwd; the environment block is a `role: "system"` entry in the messages array; in `--bare` the cwd and date are in the system block
Measured locally: `--bare` with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` set and no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` still issued a request to the custom base URL
Measured locally: an unknown model name produces a startup notice assuming a 200k window and pointing to `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT=1`

Claude Code env-vars page: `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=1` uses a shorter system prompt and abbreviated tool descriptions on any model while keeping the full tool set, hooks, MCP and CLAUDE.md; `0`, `false`, `no`, `off` opt out where an experiment or server config would enable it
Claude Code env-vars page: `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE` equals `--bare`, leaves Bash, file read and file edit, skips OAuth and keychain so auth must come from `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `apiKeyHelper`

Claude Code env-vars page: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS=1` removes commit/PR workflow instructions and the git status snapshot; `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS=1` stops all CLAUDE.md loading; `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS=1` removes bundled skills and workflows; `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS=1` removes Explore and Plan

Claude Code env-vars page: with a non-first-party `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, MCP tool search is off by default and `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=true` re-enables it only if the proxy forwards `tool_reference` blocks

Claude Code CLI reference: `--disallowedTools "mcp__*"` removes every MCP tool from context, and a bare tool name in `--disallowedTools` removes it from Claude's context; `--tools` does not affect MCP tools; the default tool set on macOS omits Glob and Grep
Claude Code CLI reference: `--safe-mode` disables customizations but keeps built-in tools and normal auth, unlike `--bare`; `--disable-slash-commands` disables all skills and commands

Piebald-AI extraction of v2.1.289 gives per-fragment token counts, e.g. TodoWrite tool description 2,037 tokens, Agent usage notes 1,934, Bash git-commit instructions 1,477, EnterPlanMode 1,296, Bash PR instructions 864, Grep 437, ReadFile 578 versus a compact 285
Inferred: git-instruction removal saves about 2.3k tokens on harnesses that include both Bash git fragments (1,477 plus 864 from Piebald's list)

Spicyneuron replaced Claude Code's system message (over 20,000 tokens including skills, commands and tool definitions) with a ~25-line prompt plus a shell-built `<env>` block (platform, date, cwd, `tree -L 2`, git branch and last five commits) passed through claude-code-router's `--system-prompt`, and says the combination with the six-tool list reaches under 8k

Measured locally on OpenCode 1.18.34 (clean HOME, OpenAI-compatible provider): default first request is 6.7k tokens (system 2,022, 10 tools 4,698); tools bash, edit, glob, grep, read, skill, task, todowrite, webfetch, write
Measured locally: OpenCode with `tools` set false for webfetch, task, todowrite, skill gives 4.7k tokens (6 tools 2,833); adding an agent `prompt` of one sentence gives 2.9k (system 104)

Measured locally: with this user's `~/.claude` present, OpenCode's default first request was 102.6k tokens, system 97.9k, because every Claude skill is listed; disabling the `skill` tool dropped system to 1.87k
Measured locally: OpenCode `"patch": false` in `tools` also removes edit and write
Measured locally: OpenCode's title-generation request is a separate 515-token call with no tools

OpenCode docs: `tools` config disables tools by name; per-agent `tools` and `prompt` (including `{file:./prompts/build.txt}`) override; `small_model` selects the title/lightweight-task model; `lsp` and `formatter` are off unless configured
OpenCode docs: per-agent `prompt` replaces the agent's system prompt with a file and per-agent `tools` restricts tools

Measured locally on Aider: with `--map-tokens 0` and the default edit format for an unknown model the first request is 591 tokens (system about 253, plus a 223-token in-context example); Aider sends no tool schemas
Aider repo map default budget is 1,024 tokens (log line `Repo-map: using 1024 tokens`), with `map_multiplier_no_files` 2 when no files are in chat

Cline's "Use compact prompt" setting is about 10% the size of the full system prompt, aimed at local models, at the cost of MCP tools, Focus Chain and MTP; Cline's guidance pairs it with KV cache quantization off in LM Studio
Cline on Ollama fails most often because the default context truncates Cline's system prompt and file context; raise num_ctx to 16K-32K

Third-party budget table for local agents: harness system prompt 2,000-10,000 tokens, tool/MCP schemas 500-25,000+, rules file 300-1,500, repo map 1,000-5,000; seven typical MCP servers about 25k+ tokens, three lean ones about 6k; rule of thumb: cut if tools plus system exceed a quarter of the window
LM Studio's Claude Code guide recommends at least 25K context
Scott Spence measured one MCP server at 710 tokens per tool on average (20 tools, 14.1k tokens) and 82k tokens for a seven-server `/context` warning, and cut descriptions to shrink them

Derived cold-start TTFT = tokens / prefill rate, using rates already in the existing dossiers (174 t/s M4 24 GB 9B; 435 t/s M1 Max 35B-A3B; about 1,000 t/s M5 Max 27B dense estimate; 1,500 t/s M4 Max 35B-A3B; 3,300 t/s M5 Max 7B). 14.0k tokens: 80 s, 32 s, 14 s, 9.3 s, 4.2 s. 3.9k: 22 s, 9.0 s, 3.9 s, 2.6 s, 1.2 s. 0.75k: 4.3 s, 1.7 s, 0.75 s, 0.5 s, 0.23 s. 66k (heavy real profile): about 380 s, 152 s, 66 s, 44 s, 20 s, before the quadratic attention penalty

Inferred: because Claude Code's request grows the prefix by tool results every turn, the saving from slimming is a fixed per-miss amount (about 10k tokens for 14k to 3.9k), so its value scales with how often misses happen (new session, restart, compaction, subagent, slot eviction)

Recommended minimal config for a 24-48 GB Mac, tool use needed: `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS=1 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS=1 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=<server window> claude --strict-mcp-config --tools "Bash,Read,Edit,Write,Grep,Glob" --disable-slash-commands --system-prompt-file <your 25-line prompt>` (about 2.7-4.2k tokens)
Recommended floor config: `claude --bare` with `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` or API key and `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` (about 0.75k tokens, Bash/Read/Edit only)
